model_kind: encoder-only verifier: last-token pooled Qwen3-8B hidden state plus two MLP projection heads
limiting_reason: serving default of upstream clm-serve (2048); traced prefill buckets 128/1024/2048 captured at startup; longer inputs are truncated to their last 2048 tokens
capacity_evidence: doc/full_model/fidelity_accuracy.json (2047 and 2048-token corpus texts, cosine >= 0.9996), doc/optimized_full_model/bench_accuracy.json (2048-token rows), doc/optimized_full_model/replay_trace_check_bfp8_attn.json (2048 variants)
input_truncation: tail: the last max_tokens tokens are kept, matching vLLM truncate_prompt_tokens as used by clm-serve
decode_contract: not applicable (encoder-only; no autoregressive decode, no KV reuse across requests)
batch_contract: right-padded batches grouped by padded prefill length (128, 1024, 2048); per-user last token index
output: 4096-d L2-normalized float32 embedding per input; heads produce 512-d projections; score = 100 * cosine
